dct_description_sm: These datasets accompany a paper published in Environmental Toxicology and Chemistry titled "Effects of microplastics on survival, reproduction, and the microbiome of the freshwater oligochaete Tubifex tubifex". These data include measurements of microplastic accumulation in Tubifex tubifex tissues and biological responses (survival and reproduction) following chronic exposure to microplastics of different sizes, shapes, polymer types, and conditions.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Effects of microplastics on survival, reproduction, and the microbiome of the freshwater oligochaete Tubifex tubifex
